meta.title: chore: simplify project selector
meta.body_summary: Remove intermediate ProjectSelectOption state and use projects array directly from context to populate selector list, reducing redundant state management and improving performance.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex simplified project selector by removing redundant state; CodeRabbit praised and suggested minor defenses; maintainer approved 'lgtm' with no performance evidence required.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 40 changed lines, this is a very small refactor by absolute volume. It fits a low-risk, quick-merge chore that simplifies state management; the outcome aligns with the low barrier for such changes.

review_details.performance_claim: Streamlined project selector for improved performance and responsiveness by eliminating intermediate state mapping.

core_change_summary.description: In frontend/src/components/layout/project-selector.tsx, removed the ProjectSelectOption interface and the useEffect/useState that created a derived list from projects. Now directly maps over the projects array from context, using project objects directly. Net deletion of 24 lines.
change_trajectory: Single commit removed intermediate state mapping and simplified rendering logic.

Human maintainer approved with 'lgtm' comment, no changes requested.
Vercel deployment preview for aci-dev-portal was successful.
